title: SSH helper acknowledges unfinished cleanup and loses retryable ownership after failure
causalEvidence: Three pre-change regressions show overlapping close returns before held native-success/native-failure finalization, and repeated close leaves a failed reservation directory. The same final runnable application against the complete old compiled SSH graph cannot acknowledge retry, loses reservation evidence or leaves the private root, and exits127. Updated native wire cases retain evidence, refuse new effects, acknowledge retry/repeat, exit0 and complete one original host permit only after native range exit.
behavior: Stable coalesced cleanup callbacks remain owned until success. Closing denies new work permanently while failures allow a later cleanup attempt. Helper providers/private root remain available while process cleanup is unconfirmed; a later close can retry without replaying effects. Direct results keep their independent bounded retention.
